description: Normalize two software prices to a first-year cost using seats, billing periods, setup fees, and expected usage charges. Returns an evidence-bounded result and the canonical web tool URL.

aBilling.description: How option A's price is charged: monthly prices are multiplied by 12 for the first year, annual and one-time prices are counted once.

aName.description: Label for the first option, used in the result.

aPrice.description: Option A list price per seat in US dollars as a plain number. It is per month when aBilling is monthly, per year when annual, and a single payment when one-time.

aSetup.description: Optional one-time setup or onboarding fee for option A in US dollars. Defaults to 0 when omitted.

aUsage.description: Optional expected usage-based charges for option A in US dollars per month, such as overages. Counted for 12 months. Defaults to 0.

bBilling.description: How option B's price is charged: monthly prices are multiplied by 12 for the first year, annual and one-time prices are counted once.

bName.description: Label for the second option, used in the result.

bPrice.description: Option B list price per seat in US dollars as a plain number. It is per month when bBilling is monthly, per year when annual, and a single payment when one-time.

bSetup.description: Optional one-time setup or onboarding fee for option B in US dollars. Defaults to 0 when omitted.

bUsage.description: Optional expected usage-based charges for option B in US dollars per month, such as overages. Counted for 12 months. Defaults to 0.

seats.description: Number of people who will need a licence, as a whole number. Both options are priced for this same count.

name: toolfound_software_cost_comparison
title: Software cost comparison
